'''C9-4O''' was a [[Shopkeeper droid/Legends|shopkeeper droid]] who was active during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During the war the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] worked on [[Carrick Station]], where it sold [[targeting device]]s and [[Color/Legends|blue]] [[sparkle powder]]. C9-4O had golden plating, yellow [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]], and was capable of projecting a [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] interface from its left [[Limb/Legends|arm]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
C9-4O first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', an [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] released in [[2011]] by [[BioWare]]. In the game the droid acts as a social items vendor on the Republic fleet.<ref name="TOR" />
